name: Extend Finset probabilistic framework to infinite spaces via MeasureTheory

problemStatement.formal: Show that the gallery's Finset-based expectation framework embeds into Mathlib MeasureTheory by identifying finite uniform expectation with the Bochner integral, then prove measure-theoretic first-moment and linearity statements.
problemStatement.plain: Bridge the finite probabilistic-method proofs to Mathlib's measure-theory probability tools.
whyMatters: Connects the gallery's elementary finite probability API to Mathlib's standard analytic probability framework.
Lets future probabilistic-method results reuse integral linearity and indicator expectation lemmas.
Creates a route from first-moment arguments toward richer measure-theoretic concentration tools.

proven: Proofs/ProbMethodExpectationOQ01.lean constructs the finite uniform probability bridge and proves Finset expectation equals the Bochner integral.
The file proves measure-theoretic first-moment, linearity via integral_add, and indicator expectation facts.
Proof metadata records 120 lines, 5 theorems, 2 definitions, 0 axioms, and 0 sorries.
open: The proof metadata lists IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformProbMeasure alpha) as a future improvement.
Second-moment, Lovasz local lemma, and concentration-inequality extensions remain future measure-theoretic work.
knownResults.goal: Connect the gallery's finite probabilistic method to Mathlib MeasureTheory in the research index.

insights: Linearity of expectation is just integral_add in MeasureTheory (one-liner!)
Counting measure gives uniform distribution on finite types
First moment method needs Markov's inequality + integrability
knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Bridge from Finset to MeasureTheory. Proved linearity + indicator expectation.
